VOID v1.0.0 - Installation Instructions
===========================================

INSTALLATION:
1. Double-click "VOID.pkg"
2. Follow the installation prompts
3. The installer copies VOID to your user plugin folders:
   - VST3: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/VOID.vst3
   - AU:   ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/VOID.component

FIRST USE (IMPORTANT):
macOS may show a security warning because this plugin is not notarized.
1. Open your DAW; when VOID is blocked on first load,
2. go to System Settings > Privacy & Security,
3. click "Open Anyway" next to the VOID warning and confirm.
You only need to do this once per plugin format (VST3 and AU).
If the PKG itself is blocked: right-click it > Open.

PLUGIN INFO:
- Version: 1.0.0
- Formats: VST3 (Ableton Live, Reaper, Cubase, Bitwig, FL Studio, Studio One),
  AU (Logic Pro, GarageBand)
- A monochrome sample-warp instrument: drop a sample, play it from C3,
  warp it through 60 modes, 34 filters, granular clouds and a 10-LFO
  modulation matrix. SLICE mode chops it onto MIDI keys from C1 (transient
  detection, hand-editing, strength-ordered SENS). One-Shot trigger mode
  plays the whole sample from a single tap. Samples and presets travel
  inside your DAW project.
- Output is protected by a brickwall limiter with 0.1 dB headroom.

UNINSTALLATION:
1. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/VOID.vst3
2. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/VOID.component
3. Restart your DAW.

COMPATIBILITY:
- macOS 14.6 or later recommended.
